title: APISR and Real-CUGAN 4x Anime Upscaler
description: Batch anime image super-resolution. Send image URLs under input.images and choose input.upscaleType: apisr (default) or real-cugan. For Real-CUGAN, set input.noiseLevel from 0 (off) to 3 (strong). The selected backend handles the initial 4x upscale and optional repeated 2x passes (APISR_REPEAT_2X). Results are resized to 2048px wide by default and returned as base64 JPEG + AVIF, indexed in input order.
